overview_description.description:
ONEKEY is a smart key entry system where users can freely control access to their cars, homes, and offices using only a smartphone. It keeps your car and home safe from all forms of hacking including relay station attack (RSA). Their soundwave-based technology overcomes the limitations of Bluetooth-only solutions.

ONEKEY smartphone-based secure passive entry solution is both safe and convenient without the need for any physical keys. The system provides strong security through the 2 channel authentication process. It recognizes your exact position using soundwaves and the control door system accordingly.
